metadata.question: Did the turbidity of the Beaufort Sea (specifically at 69.954148, -136.325766) increase between June 14, 2012, and July 5, 2012?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Beaufort Sea at coordinates (69.954148, -136.325766) - a point geometry - Dates: June 14, 2012 and July 5, 2012 (two specific dates) - Collection: Sentinel-2 has global coverage but started in June 2015, so it won't work for 2012. Landsat 8 started in 2013, so won't work either. I need to use Landsat 7 (available from 1999 onwards) or MODIS. - For water turbidity, Landsat 7 ETM+ is appropriate (30m resolution, suitable for coastal water analysis). 2. Masking strategy: - Cloud mask the images to get clear observations of turbidity - Use a water mask to isolate the sea area - Calculate turbidity using a spectral index (e.g., Red/Blue ratio or similar turbidity-sensitive bands) 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs. Null: - Check if images exist for each date (C1 if no data) - Check pixel count after cloud masking (C2 if no valid pixels) - Check if turbidity values are valid numbers in reasonable range (C3 if NaN or invalid) - Compare turbidity: if June < July, answer A (increase); if June >= July, answer B (no increase) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometry (point at Beaufort Sea) const lon = -136.325766; const lat = 69.954148; const point = ee.Geometry.Point([lon, lat]); const buffer = point.buffer(5000); // 5km buffer for analysis // 2. Define time periods const date1_start = '2012-06-10'; const date1_end = '2012-06-18'; const date2_start = '2012-07-01'; const date2_end = '2012-07-10'; // 3. Load Landsat 7 (available for 2012) const col1 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(buffer) .filterDate(date1_start, date1_end) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 50)); const col2 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(buffer) .filterDate(date2_start, date2_end) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 50)); const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log('June 2012 Images: ' + size1); console.log('July 2012 Images: ' + size2); // Check for empty collections if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log('Insufficient data for one or both dates.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Prepare images and mask clouds const prepareImage = function(img) { // QA_PIXEL band for cloud masking const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL'); const cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(32).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(64).eq(0)); return img.updateMask(cloud).select(['SR_B1', 'SR_B2', 'SR_B3', 'SR_B4']); }; const img1 = col1.map(prepareImage).mosaic(); const img2 = col2.map(prepareImage).mosaic(); // 5. Calculate turbidity index (Red/Blue ratio as proxy for turbidity) // Higher ratio = higher turbidity const turbidity1 = img1.select('SR_B3').divide(img1.select('SR_B1')) .rename('turbidity'); const turbidity2 = img2.select('SR_B3').divide(img2.select('SR_B1')) .rename('turbidity'); // 6. Extract turbidity values const stats1 = turbidity1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: buffer, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2 = turbidity2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: buffer, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); // Check pixel counts const count1 = turbidity1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: buffer, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const count2 = turbidity2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: buffer, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const val1 = stats1.get('turbidity').getInfo(); const val2 = stats2.get('turbidity').getInfo(); const cnt1 = count1.get('turbidity').getInfo(); const cnt2 = count2.get('turbidity').getInfo(); console.log('June Turbidity: ' + (val1 !== null ? val1.toFixed(4) : 'null') + ' (Pixels: ' + cnt1 + ')'); console.log('July Turbidity: ' + (val2 !== null ? val2.toFixed(4) : 'null') + ' (Pixels: ' + cnt2 + ')'); // 7. Validation if (cnt1 === 0 || cnt2 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after cloud masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (val1 === null || val2 === null || isNaN(val1) || isNaN(val2)) { console.log('Invalid turbidity calculation.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 8. Final comparison const increased = val2 > val1; if (increased) { console.log('Turbidity increased from June to July.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Turbidity did not increase.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
